title: Monkey-Time Bucket-Balls
description: A film that asks the audience to experience what a soda feels “when it’s drunk by me.”
quote: My goodness. I’m thirsty. So, so thirsty.
altHero: Sinjin, a teen boy, standing in a white room with a window with green curtains
alt1: Sinjin sees a soda can on a table
alt4: POV of the soda, looking at Sinjin’s open mouth
